Week 1 2024
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

## ===========================
## 📅 Upload Week 1 Datasets
## ===========================
defensive_summary_week1 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Data/Defense/Week 1/Week 1 Defensive Summary 2024.csv")
defensive_PassRush_week1 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Data/Defense/Week 1/Week 1 Pass Rush 2024 .csv")
defensive_RushDefense_week1 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Data/Defense/Week 1/Week 1 Rush Defense 2024.csv")
defensive_Coverage_week1 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Data/Defense/Week 1/Week 1 Coverage 2024 (FBS).csv")
defensive_tackle_week1 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Data/Defense/Week 1/Week 1 Tackling 2024.csv")

## ===========================
## Remove Duplicate Players
## ===========================
join_cols <- c("Name", "Season", "Team", "Position")

defensive_summary_week1 <- defensive_summary_week1 %>%
  distinct(across(all_of(join_cols)), .keep_all = TRUE)

defensive_PassRush_week1 <- defensive_PassRush_week1 %>%
  distinct(across(all_of(join_cols)), .keep_all = TRUE)

defensive_RushDefense_week1 <- defensive_RushDefense_week1 %>%
  distinct(across(all_of(join_cols)), .keep_all = TRUE)

defensive_Coverage_week1 <- defensive_Coverage_week1 %>%
  distinct(across(all_of(join_cols)), .keep_all = TRUE)

defensive_tackle_week1 <- defensive_tackle_week1 %>%
  distinct(across(all_of(join_cols)), .keep_all = TRUE)

## ===========================
## Remove Duplicate Metadata
## ===========================
drop_cols <- c(
  "Conference",
  "Defensive.Snaps",
  "Defensive.Grades",
  "Run.Defense.Grade",
  "Pass.Rush.Grade",
  "Coverage.Grade"
)

defensive_PassRush_week1 <- defensive_PassRush_week1 %>%
  select(-any_of(drop_cols))

defensive_RushDefense_week1 <- defensive_RushDefense_week1 %>%
  select(-any_of(drop_cols))

defensive_Coverage_week1 <- defensive_Coverage_week1 %>%
  select(-any_of(drop_cols))

defensive_tackle_week1 <- defensive_tackle_week1 %>%
  select(-any_of(drop_cols))

## ===========================
## Join Everything
## ===========================
defensive_combined_week1 <- defensive_summary_week1 %>%
  left_join(defensive_PassRush_week1, by = join_cols, relationship = "one-to-one") %>%
  left_join(defensive_RushDefense_week1, by = join_cols, relationship = "one-to-one") %>%
  left_join(defensive_Coverage_week1, by = join_cols, relationship = "one-to-one") %>%
  left_join(defensive_tackle_week1, by = join_cols, relationship = "one-to-one")

## ===========================
## Replace NaN with 0
## ===========================
defensive_combined_week1 <- defensive_combined_week1 %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace(.x, is.nan(.x), 0)))

## ===========================
## Conference Groups
## ===========================
p4_conference <- c("ACC", "Big 12", "Big Ten", "SEC", "Pac-12")
g5_conference <- c("MAC", "AAC", "C-USA", "MWC", "Sun Belt", "IND (FBS)")

## ===========================
## Week 1 Defensive Line
## ===========================
dl_week1_2024 <- defensive_combined_week1 %>%
  filter(
    Position %in% c("DLT", "DRT", "NLT", "NRT", "NT", "LE", "RE", "DI"),
    Defensive.Snaps >= 15,
    Defensive.Snaps < 100
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Conference_Level = case_when(
      Conference %in% p4_conference ~ "P4",
      Conference %in% g5_conference ~ "G5",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(Name, Season, Team, Position, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.nan(.x), NA, .x))) %>%
  select(-matches("\\.x$"), -matches("\\.y$"), -matches("\\.x\\.x$"), -matches("\\.y\\.y$"))

View(dl_week1_2024)
colnames(dl_week1_2024)

## ===========================
## Week 1 Edge Defenders
## ===========================
de_week1_2024 <- defensive_combined_week1 %>%
  filter(
    Position %in% c("LEO", "REO", "LOLB", "ROLB", "ED"),
    Defensive.Snaps >= 15,
    Defensive.Snaps < 100
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Conference_Level = case_when(
      Conference %in% p4_conference ~ "P4",
      Conference %in% g5_conference ~ "G5",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(Name, Season, Team, Position, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.nan(.x), NA, .x))) %>%
  select(-matches("\\.x$"), -matches("\\.y$"), -matches("\\.x\\.x$"), -matches("\\.y\\.y$"))

View(de_week1_2024)
colnames(de_week1_2024)

## Week 1 Linebackers
## ===========================

  filter(
    Position %in% c("RILB", "LLB", "LILB", "MLB", "LB"),

    Defensive.Snaps < 100
  ) %>%
```

```{r}
defensive_Coverage_week2 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Data/Defense/Week 2/Week 2 Coverage 2024 (FBS).csv")

## ===========================

  cat("\nGetting Conference from PassRush...\n")
  defensive_summary_week2 <- defensive_summary_week2 %>%
    left_join(
      defensive_PassRush_week2 %>% 
        select(Name, Season, Team, Position, Conference),

    )
}

# If still no Conference, try RushDefense
if (!"Conference" %in% colnames(defensive_summary_week2)) {
  cat("Getting Conference from RushDefense...\n")

    )
}

# If still no Conference, try Coverage

  cat("Getting Conference from Coverage...\n")
  defensive_summary_week2 <- defensive_summary_week2 %>%
    left_join(
      defensive_Coverage_week2 %>% 
        select(Name, Season, Team, Position, Conference),
      by = c("Name", "Season", "Team", "Position")
    )
}

# If still no Conference, try Tackle
if (!"Conference" %in% colnames(defensive_summary_week2)) {
  cat("Getting Conference from Tackle...\n")
  defensive_summary_week2 <- defensive_summary_week2 %>%
    left_join(
      defensive_tackle_week2 %>% 
        select(Name, Season, Team, Position, Conference),
      by = c("Name", "Season", "Team", "Position")
    )
}

## ===========================

    )
```
```{r}
}

    )
}

g5_conference <- c("MAC", "AAC", "C-USA", "MWC", "Sun Belt", "IND (FBS)")

  select(-matches("\\.x$"), -matches("\\.y$"), -matches("\\.x\\.x$"), -matches("\\.y\\.y$"))
```

```{r}
defensive_Coverage_week9 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Data/Defense/Week 9/Week 9 Coverage 2024 (FBS).csv")

## ===========================
## Check for Conference column

cat("=== CHECKING FOR CONFERENCE ===\n")

cat("PassRush has Conference:", "Conference" %in% colnames(defensive_PassRush_week9), "\n")
cat("RushDefense has Conference:", "Conference" %in% colnames(defensive_RushDefense_week9), "\n")
cat("Coverage has Conference:", "Conference" %in% colnames(defensive_Coverage_week9), "\n")
cat("Tackle has Conference:", "Conference" %in% colnames(defensive_tackle_week9), "\n")

## ===========================
## Get Conference from wherever it exists

join_cols <- c("Name", "Season", "Team", "Position")

# If summary doesn't have Conference, try to get it from PassRush
if (!"Conference" %in% colnames(defensive_summary_week9)) {
  cat("\nGetting Conference from PassRush...\n")
  defensive_summary_week9 <- defensive_summary_week9 %>%
    left_join(
      defensive_PassRush_week9 %>% 
        select(Name, Season, Team, Position, Conference),
      by = c("Name", "Season", "Team", "Position")
    )
}

# If still no Conference, try RushDefense
if (!"Conference" %in% colnames(defensive_summary_week9)) {
  cat("Getting Conference from RushDefense...\n")
  defensive_summary_week9 <- defensive_summary_week9 %>%
    left_join(
      defensive_RushDefense_week9 %>% 
        select(Name, Season, Team, Position, Conference),
      by = c("Name", "Season", "Team", "Position")
    )
}

# If still no Conference, try Coverage
if (!"Conference" %in% colnames(defensive_summary_week9)) {
  cat("Getting Conference from Coverage...\n")
  defensive_summary_week9 <- defensive_summary_week9 %>%
    left_join(
      defensive_Coverage_week9 %>% 
        select(Name, Season, Team, Position, Conference),
      by = c("Name", "Season", "Team", "Position")
    )
}

# If still no Conference, try Tackle
if (!"Conference" %in% colnames(defensive_summary_week9)) {
  cat("Getting Conference from Tackle...\n")
  defensive_summary_week9 <- defensive_summary_week9 %>%
    left_join(
      defensive_tackle_week9 %>% 
        select(Name, Season, Team, Position, Conference),
      by = c("Name", "Season", "Team", "Position")
    )
}

## ===========================
## Remove Duplicate Players
## ===========================
defensive_summary_week9 <- defensive_summary_week9 %>%
  distinct(across(all_of(join_cols)), .keep_all = TRUE)

defensive_PassRush_week9 <- defensive_PassRush_week9 %>%
  distinct(across(all_of(join_cols)), .keep_all = TRUE)

defensive_RushDefense_week9 <- defensive_RushDefense_week9 %>%
  distinct(across(all_of(join_cols)), .keep_all = TRUE)

defensive_Coverage_week9 <- defensive_Coverage_week9 %>%
  distinct(across(all_of(join_cols)), .keep_all = TRUE)

defensive_tackle_week9 <- defensive_tackle_week9 %>%
  distinct(across(all_of(join_cols)), .keep_all = TRUE)

## ===========================

  "Defensive.Snaps",
  "Defensive.Grades",

)

defensive_Coverage_week9 <- defensive_Coverage_week9 %>%
```

```{r}
# If still no Conference, try RushDefense
```

```{r}
  left_join(defensive_RushDefense_week11, by = join_cols, relationship = "one-to-one") %>%
  left_join(defensive_Coverage_week11, by = join_cols, relationship = "one-to-one") %>%

  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace(.x, is.nan(.x), 0)))

## ===========================
## Conference Groups
## ===========================

g5_conference <- c("MAC", "AAC", "C-USA", "MWC", "Sun Belt", "IND (FBS)")

## ===========================

dl_week11_2024 <- defensive_combined_week11 %>%

    Defensive.Snaps < 100
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Conference_Level = case_when(
      Conference %in% p4_conference ~ "P4",
      Conference %in% g5_conference ~ "G5",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(Name, Season, Team, Position, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.nan(.x), NA, .x))) %>%
  select(-matches("\\.x$"), -matches("\\.y$"), -matches("\\.x\\.x$"), -matches("\\.y\\.y$"))
```

```{r}
defensive_RushDefense_week14 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Data/Defense/Week 14/Week 14 Rush Defense 2024.csv")
defensive_Coverage_week14 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Data/Defense/Week 14/Week 14 Coverage 2024 (FBS).csv")
defensive_tackle_week14 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Data/Defense/Week 14/Week 14 Tackling 2024.csv")

## ===========================
## Check for Conference column
## ===========================
cat("=== CHECKING FOR CONFERENCE ===\n")
cat("Summary has Conference:", "Conference" %in% colnames(defensive_summary_week14), "\n")
cat("PassRush has Conference:", "Conference" %in% colnames(defensive_PassRush_week14), "\n")
cat("RushDefense has Conference:", "Conference" %in% colnames(defensive_RushDefense_week14), "\n")
cat("Coverage has Conference:", "Conference" %in% colnames(defensive_Coverage_week14), "\n")
cat("Tackle has Conference:", "Conference" %in% colnames(defensive_tackle_week14), "\n")

## ===========================
## Get Conference from wherever it exists
## ===========================
join_cols <- c("Name", "Season", "Team", "Position")

# If summary doesn't have Conference, try to get it from PassRush
if (!"Conference" %in% colnames(defensive_summary_week14)) {
  cat("\nGetting Conference from PassRush...\n")
  defensive_summary_week14 <- defensive_summary_week14 %>%
    left_join(
      defensive_PassRush_week14 %>% 
        select(Name, Season, Team, Position, Conference),
      by = c("Name", "Season", "Team", "Position")
    )
}

# If still no Conference, try RushDefense
if (!"Conference" %in% colnames(defensive_summary_week14)) {
  cat("Getting Conference from RushDefense...\n")
  defensive_summary_week14 <- defensive_summary_week14 %>%
    left_join(
      defensive_RushDefense_week14 %>% 
        select(Name, Season, Team, Position, Conference),
      by = c("Name", "Season", "Team", "Position")
    )
}

# If still no Conference, try Coverage
if (!"Conference" %in% colnames(defensive_summary_week14)) {
  cat("Getting Conference from Coverage...\n")
  defensive_summary_week14 <- defensive_summary_week14 %>%
    left_join(
      defensive_Coverage_week14 %>% 
        select(Name, Season, Team, Position, Conference),
      by = c("Name", "Season", "Team", "Position")
    )
}

# If still no Conference, try Tackle

  defensive_summary_week14 <- defensive_summary_week14 %>%

      by = c("Name", "Season", "Team", "Position")
    )
}

defensive_RushDefense_week14 <- defensive_RushDefense_week14 %>%
```
